title: Normalized resolution class restriction between two arbitrary opens
statement: Let f:X -> S be any scheme morphism, F any module, I an injective resolution and p a natural number. Let W <= V be opens of S, U an open of X with specified equality U=f inverse V, and R,R prime augmentation-preserving restricted-resolution section identifications for I over U and f inverse W. The class maps c,c prime are resolutionSectionClass followed by I.isoRightDerivedObj inverse, with R.sections transported by the displayed equality for c. Then c prime(cohomologyOpenRestriction(F,U,f inverse W)(y)) equals restriction to W of c(y) for every derived module-section class y on U. Here cohomologyOpenRestriction is constructed from the restriction adjunction unit and the canonical restriction-composition isomorphism. No affineness, qcqs, quasi-coherence or scalar extension is assumed.

source.place: Lemma 20.7.3 and the restriction equation 20.7.1.1 (01E2); Remark 20.14.2 (01FB). Sources read on 2026-10-13.

proof.text: Eliminate U = f inverse V. Apply restrictedResolution_open_cohomology to I, the two inverse-image opens, R and R prime. Its termwise section restriction map equals restriction of the pushed complex K by componentwise reflexivity.

The proved private sectionClass_open_restriction lemma uses NatTrans.app_homology for the transformation between evaluations at V and W, followed by naturality of sectionCohomologyTheta. Compose the raw equality with the evaluation homology comparison and theta to obtain the unnormalized sectionClass restriction identity.

Compose with Hom.app of I.isoRightDerivedObj inverse at W. Naturality of that sheaf morphism moves it across restriction. Apply ConcreteCategory.congr_hom to y; Iso.trans_refl eliminates the equality transport of sections after substitution.

theorem resolutionSectionClass_open_restriction
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) (F : X.Modules) (I : InjectiveResolution F)
    (p : ℕ) (V W : S.Opens) (eWV : W ≤ V)
    (U : X.Opens) (e : U = f ⁻¹ᵁ V) (R : RestrictedResolutionSections I U)
    (R' : RestrictedResolutionSections I (f ⁻¹ᵁ W)) :
    let eU : f ⁻¹ᵁ W ≤ U := by rw [e]; exact f.preimage_mono eWV
    let K := ((pushforward f).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj I.cocomplex
    let Q := ((pushforward f).rightDerived p).obj F
    let c := resolutionSectionClass R.resolution K V
      (R.sections ≪≫ eqToIso (congrArg (fun T ↦
        ((RingedSpace.openModuleSections X.toRingedSpace T).mapHomologicalComplex
          (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj I.cocomplex) e)) p ≫
      Hom.app (I.isoRightDerivedObj (pushforward f) p).inv V
    let c' := resolutionSectionClass R'.resolution K W R'.sections p ≫
      Hom.app (I.isoRightDerivedObj (pushforward f) p).inv W
    ∀ y : (RingedSpace.moduleCohomology U.toScheme.toRingedSpace p).obj
        ((restrictFunctor U.ι).obj F),
      c' (cohomologyOpenRestriction F U (f ⁻¹ᵁ W) eU p y) =
        Q.presheaf.map (homOfLE eWV).op (c y)
